تلتحمين (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِمِينَ (taltaḥimīna) /tal.ta.ħi.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# تُلْتَحَمِينَ (tultaḥamīna) /tul.ta.ħa.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
